title: Faulty AC & Water Leakage in Central Lab Room 302
description: The primary AC unit in Lab 302 has been leaking water directly onto workstation desks 14-16. This poses an electrical risk and prevents our AI/ML lab batches from conducting practical sessions.

timeline.message: Grievance lodged online with supporting lab photographs.
Acknowledged by Redressal Desk. Flagged as High Urgency due to laboratory equipment risk.
timeline.actor: Dr. Anita Rao (Dean of Student Welfare)

timeline.message: HVAC contractor inspected unit. Drain pan replaced, final sealing underway before noon tomorrow.

resolutionNotes: Drain pan replacement ordered; temporary water shielding installed. Expected completion within 12 hours.

title: Discrepancy in Semester V Fee Receipt & Late Fine Refund
description: I paid the semester fees via net banking on September 10th (UTR: SBIN0092837192). However, my student portal is still reflecting a late fine charge of ₹2,500 that was deducted erroneously.
assignedTo: Mr. S. K. Raman (Finance & Accounts Officer)

timeline.message: Grievance lodged with attached bank payment receipt.
Transaction verified with bank gateway reconciliation logs.
Reversal credit memo generated in ERP student ledger.
Late fee charge of ₹2,500 successfully adjusted against semester examination dues. Ledger balance zeroed.

resolutionNotes: Bank payment received within deadline. System sync glitch identified and corrected in ERP ledger. Late fee fully waived.
feedback: Extremely fast resolution and ledger statement was sent directly to my registered email. Thank you!

title: Hostel Block-D High-Speed Wi-Fi Disruption on Floors 3 & 4
description: Access points in corridors 3A and 4B have experienced intermittent DNS dropouts and extreme latency (>600ms) for 4 consecutive nights, interfering with online project submissions.
assignedTo: Dr. K. S. Murthy (Chief Hostel Warden)

timeline.message: Formal grievance lodged regarding network dropouts.
Assigned to Campus Network Operations Center (NOC). Diagnostic ping tests initiated.

title: Need for Extended Library Quiet Study Hours during Mid-Terms
description: Requesting Central Library reading halls to stay operational until 1:00 AM instead of 9:30 PM during the upcoming mid-semester examinations next week.
location: Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Central Library
assignedTo: Dr. Meenakshi Sundaram (Chief Librarian & IT Head)

timeline.message: Petition submitted with signatures of 120 hostellers.
Reviewed in weekly Academic Affairs advisory meeting.
Security roster updated to support midnight shifts.
Official circular issued: Library Ground & 1st Floor Study halls will stay open until 1:30 AM with security guard coverage till Oct 15.

resolutionNotes: Approved and implemented. Circular No. LIB/2026/08 published on university portal.
feedback: Huge relief for all day scholars and hostellers preparing for examinations!

title: Dangerous Pothole & Lack of Street Light near Gate 3 Bus Stop
description: A deep trench has formed near the Gate 3 internal bus shelter after recent monsoon showers. Multiple two-wheelers have skidded after sunset due to broken sodium lamps.

timeline.message: Critical priority grievance registered with geo-tag location.
